title: Pic. of the day
title_display_en: 3 takeaways from Trump, Xi and Putin
title_display_zh: 高彩流體表現主義 · 3 takeaways from Trump, Xi and Putin
inspiration: 3 takeaways from Trump, Xi and Putin's historic summit
style_desc: Flowing luminous pigments, organic gradients, vibrant acrylic swirls, bold layered palette knife impasto.
design_concept: 「高彩流體表現主義」：以深邃鈷藍、奔放洋紅、翡翠綠與琥珀金交織流動，將「3 takeaways from Trump, Xi and Putin's historic summit」意象昇華為充滿張力的視覺色彩。
message_conveyed: 傳達「全球脈動與人類創新的共鳴」，在快速變遷的世界中展現生生不息的文化韌性與未來希望。
design_concept_en: 'Chromatic Fluid Expressionism': Harmonizing deep cobalt blue, radiant magenta, emerald green, warm amber gold, luminous violet into fluid chromatic planes, translating '3 takeaways from Trump, Xi and Putin's historic summit' into expressive visual harmony.
message_conveyed_en: Conveys 'The Pulse of Global Innovation': Celebrating human resilience and interconnected future possibilities amidst planetary transformation.
prompt: Masterpiece fine-art abstract painting inspired by global event '3 takeaways from Trump, Xi and Putin's historic summit'. Art style: Chromatic Fluid Expressionism, Flowing luminous pigments, organic gradients, vibrant acrylic swirls, bold layered palette knife impasto. Palette: deep cobalt blue, radiant magenta, emerald green, warm amber gold, luminous violet. Rich vivid chromatic saturation, dynamic fluid composition, museum-grade textural impasto, pure abstract art, no human faces, no legible words or typography, elegant, 8k resolution.
